description: Emails a code to reset the password of an account (the answer is the same whether or not the account exists). Then reset_password. [REST: POST /api/auth/password/forgot]

lang.description: The account's language: ru, en, es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French), pt (Brazilian Portuguese) or ja (Japanese); the messages, the emails and the texts of its searches. Default en.

name: request_password_reset
title: Forgot the password
